rust_declaration.name: contains
rust_declaration.source_text:
pub const fn contains<U>(&self, item: &U) -> bool
    where
        Idx: [const] PartialOrd<U>,
        U: ?Sized + [const] PartialOrd<Idx>,
    {
        <Self as RangeBounds<Idx>>::contains(self, item)
    }

trusted_assumptions: vstd specifications for RangeFrom's RangeBounds::start_bound and end_bound implementations.
vstd's PartialOrd bridge connecting executable comparison to PartialOrdSpec under obeys_partial_cmp_spec().
rationale: Mechanically inlines RangeBounds::contains; RangeFrom's included start and unbounded end reduce the result to start <= item.
